# The Claude Cert Game

> A swipe-to-learn study app for the Claude Certified Architect — Foundations certification (CCAR-F).
> Practice questions authored from the official Anthropic exam guide. These are study aids, not official exam items.

## What this is

An interactive study tool covering the five exam domains:
- Agentic Architecture & Orchestration
- Tool Design & MCP Integration
- Claude Code Configuration & Workflows
- Prompt Engineering & Structured Output
- Context Management & Reliability

## Modes

- **Swipe & Discover** — core concept cards, answered by swiping toward the right option
- **Challenge** — certification-style questions, including select-all-that-apply
- **Recall** — spaced repetition over concepts you have not seen in a while

## Notes

- Progress is stored locally in the browser only; there is no account or server.
- [About this project](https://github.com/)
